script.title: HIRING A BABYSITTER
script.scene_zh: 家中客廳 · 面談保母
script.story_hook: A dad interviews a sitter for Friday night.
script.intro_zh: 爸爸在家裡面試星期五晚上的保母。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back, everyone! Today we're hiring a babysitter.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎回來！今天我們來面試一位保母。
script.outro: That's the interview done! Listen again and repeat each line.
script.outro_zh: 面試就到這裡！再聽一次，跟著每句唸出來。
script.practice_intro_en: Let's practice: listen, then say it with me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 我們來練習：先聽，再跟著我一起說。
script.char_a_description: a tall, lean man in his forties with short sandy-blond hair and a faded tattoo on his forearm, wearing a wrinkled oxford shirt with rolled sleeves, rubbing the back of his neck
script.char_b_description: a petite college girl of nineteen with bright burgundy shoulder-length hair in a side braid, wearing an oversized denim jacket and canvas sneakers, bouncing her heel when nervous
script.youtube_title: 【👶📋請保母英文】「if anything feels off」怎麼說？面試保母必問的句型與費率｜🎧Babysitter Interview English
script.youtube_title_en: "If Anything Feels Off" — Hiring a Babysitter for Friday Night
script.youtube_description:
要出門一個晚上，保母怎麼請？這段面試保母的真實對話，帶你一次學會問就寢時間、談好時薪、留緊急聯絡。整段 18 句美式日常英語，附上繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽完就能自己開口問。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
Need an evening out? This real babysitter interview teaches you to ask about bedtime, agree on an hourly rate, and leave an emergency number. 18 lines of everyday American English with Traditional Chinese meaning and IPA, plus a repeat-after-me section so the phrases stick.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】👶📋請保母英文｜問睡覺時間・談好時薪・留緊急電話｜聽完就會用｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
第一次在家裡面試保母，該問什麼？
時薪、睡覺時間、點心規定，要用怎麼說？
聽到小孩的事，怎麼交代才安心？

這一集帶大家走進一個家的客廳，跟著爸爸從請對方坐下、問就寢流程、談好時薪，到留下備用電話與推薦人，全程都是自然的日常美式英語。

你會聽到：
🕗 問作息與規定：例如「What time is bedtime on Friday?」、「Can he have a snack before that?」。
💵 談錢與時間：例如「We're thinking fifteen an hour.」、「How long is the job?」。
📱 交代安全與聯絡：例如「Call us if anything feels off.」、「Do you have a backup number for me?」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整場面試變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次要請人照顧小孩，坐下來慢慢問就對了！
script.thumbnail_action: sitting across a kitchen table with a small notebook

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for coming by, Riley. Have a seat.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks fɔr ˈkʌmɪŋ baɪ ˈraɪli hæv ə sit/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你特地跑一趟，Riley。請坐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks for having me! So, how old is Sam?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks fɔr ˈhævɪŋ mi soʊ haʊ oʊld ɪz sæm/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你們邀請！那個，Sam 幾歲了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He's six, and he's pretty easy going.
dialogue.phonetic: /hiz sɪks ənd hiz ˈprɪti ˈizi ˌɡoʊɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 他六歲，個性挺好相處的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great. What time is bedtime on Friday?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt wʌt ˈtaɪm ɪz ˈbɛdˌtaɪm ɑn ˈfraɪdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。星期五幾點要睡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bath around eight, one book, lights out eight thirty.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæθ əˈraʊnd eɪt wʌn bʊk laɪts aʊt eɪt ˈθɜrti/
dialogue.zh: 八點左右洗澡、看一本書，八點半關燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. Can he have a snack before that?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt kæn hi hæv ə snæk bɪˈfɔr ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 記下了。那之前可以吃點心嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fruit only, please. He begs for candy.
dialogue.phonetic: /frut ˈoʊnli pliːz hi bɛɡz fɔr ˈkændi/
dialogue.zh: 只能吃水果。他會一直吵著要糖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Understood. Well, I'll say no nicely.
dialogue.zh: 了解，我會好好跟他說不行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Now, we're thinking fifteen an hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt naʊ wɪr ˈθɪŋkɪŋ ˈfɪftiən ən ˈaʊər/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我們想給一小時十五塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That works for me. How long is the job?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wɜrks fɔr mi haʊ lɔŋ ɪz ðə dʒɑb/
dialogue.zh: 我可以。這一次要待多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five thirty to ten, maybe eleven some nights.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ˈθɜrti tə tɛn ˈmeɪbi ɪˈlɛvən sʌm naɪts/
dialogue.zh: 五點半到十點，有些晚上會到十一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay. Do you have a backup number for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ du ju hæv ə ˈbækˌʌp ˈnʌmbər fɔr mi/
dialogue.zh: 好。你們有備用電話可以給我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, my sister's number is on the fridge.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs maɪ ˈsɪstərz ˈnʌmbər ɪz ɑn ðə frɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 有，我姊的號碼貼在冰箱上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can I text you two references tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ tɛkst ju tu ˈrɛfərənsɪz təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我今晚可以傳兩位推薦人的資訊給你嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure, and call us if anything feels off.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr ənd kɔl ʌs ɪf ˈɛniθɪŋ filz ɔf/
dialogue.zh: 當然，覺得不對勁就打電話給我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Will do. What if he gets scared at night?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl du wʌt ɪf hi ɡɛts skɛrd æt naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好的。要是他半夜害怕怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just leave his door open and text me.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst liv hɪz dɔr ˈoʊpən ənd tɛkst mi/
dialogue.zh: 就把他的門開著，然後傳訊息給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sounds good. See you Friday at five thirty!
dialogue.phonetic: /saʊndz ɡʊd si ju ˈfraɪdeɪ æt faɪv ˈθɜrti/
dialogue.zh: 聽起來很棒。星期五五點半見！
